gaps: Independent malformed/undefined-length sequence and big-endian raw-value regression fixtures.
Independent valid SOP/codec fixtures for supported syntaxes; expected rejection for unsupported HEVC/JPEG XL/Frame Deflate/Deflated Explicit VR LE. Big Endian is file-only.
Independent negative negotiation/framing/timeout/limit cases from #1319 remain unverified.
Extend CT/MR/CR transport fixtures to every advertised Storage SOP class.
External patient/study/series levels, wildcard/date/unicode and cancel cases beyond IMAGE queries.
Failure/cancel/unknown-destination sub-operation counters and timeout/retry paths.
Refused role negotiation, cancellation and mixed failure counters.
Independent MPPS N-CREATE/N-SET reference implementation; controlled wire tests do not establish full SOP/IOD conformance.
Independent Storage Commitment/UPS/Print/N-GET/PIR workflows, including reverse event reports.
TLS client certificate rejection and protocol-version matrix; external ATNA receiver and nested anonymization roundtrip.
PACS archive restart/crash recovery with on-disk/database reconciliation under transfer.
S3/Azure SDK builds against emulators and real provider semantics; existing tests use mocks.
STOW->DIMSE retrieve and DIMSE store->QIDO/WADO over HTTP with authentication.
Routing/prefetch/sync/jobs against both external PACS nodes, including retries and restart.
Independent inference-service request/result roundtrip and failure handling.
External XDS registry/repository/ATNA receiver; current registry tests use an in-process mock.
Metrics/readiness/audit under external transfer, induced failure and shutdown.
Browser workflow tests against live authenticated PACS APIs; build/lint is not behavioral verification.
Long-duration soak, sanitizer/fuzz campaigns and loss-of-power recovery are separate required evidence.
C++ module, installed consumer and supported OS/compiler matrix; see existing source-install/modules CI.
